outcome: Dysmaturation effects on multiple organ systems (lung, heart, brain, and kidney)
cohort: The discussion revolves around preterm infants, late preterm infants, and periviable fetuses who may receive antenatal corticosteroids.
finding: Despite being a pillar of treatment, the expanded use of antenatal corticosteroids (ACS) lacks solid clinical data, especially concerning optimal dose/duration, effectiveness in low-resource settings, and potential long-term dysmaturation risks on multiple organ systems in later life.
mod_finding: The use of ACS is expanding to elective C-sections with minimal Randomized Control Trial (RCT) data of long-term benefit.
gest_age: Preterm infants, late preterm infants, periviable fetuses
